artworks.title: Elizabeth, Queen of Bohemia
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a woman facing forward with her head slightly turned to the right. She has a slender face, deep-set eyes, and a small mouth. Her hair is styled with a crown-like headpiece adorned with jewels and rectangles. She wears a decorated gown with a high lace collar and embroidery. Accessories include a large necklace and a jeweled brooch. The background features intricate engravings and decorative scrolls surrounding her in an oval frame.

artworks.title: Frederick V, King of Bohemia
artworks.description: This image shows an upper-body portrait of a man facing slightly to the right, looking at the viewer. He has arched eyebrows, a mustache, a short beard, and curly hair falling just above his shoulders. He wears ornate attire with a high lace collar, a draped sash, and a crown with jewels. He holds a sword hilt in his right hand resting on a shield. Latin text surrounds the portrait, and a curtain is in the background.

artworks.title: Frederick V, King of Bohemia
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man with an oval face, short beard, delicate mustache, and neatly styled hair under a crown. He is wearing a detailed garment with a high collar, sash, and holding a sword in his left hand. The background features ornate drapery and floral motifs, with text providing identification and context.

artworks.title: Prince Frederick Henry
artworks.description: The image shows a young child standing upright from the waist up. The child has a round face, delicate features, and light curly hair. They wear an ornate lace headpiece and an elaborate garment with intricate lace details, a crisscross pattern with a pendant on the chest, and embellished sleeves. The child holds a small rattle-like object in their left hand and rests their right hand on a table edge. The background features heavy drapery.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas Grisham
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man depicted from the waist up, facing forward with his head turned slightly to his left. He has a beard and mustache, wearing a cap. His attire is ornate, featuring a decorated coat or cloak with fur trim on the shoulders and intricate patterns. The man holds a rod in his right hand and his left hand rests near his waist on a sword tucked into his belt. He wears a chain around his neck with large links. In the background, there is a decorative frame with two cherubs at the top and a circular motif surrounded by a ribbon with an inscription. The setting is monochromatic, with a detailed border containing text at the bottom of the engraving.

artworks.title: Thomae Gresham, Equi. Aura (Sir Thomas Gresham)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a regal posture. He has a long, pointed beard and wears a decorated coat, a detailed collar, a belt, and a cape. He is holding an object in his right hand. The portrait is surrounded by an ornate frame with putti and heraldic symbols. Latin inscriptions and intricate designs fill the background.

artworks.title: James I
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the chest up, facing forward. He has a full beard and mustache, curly hair under a broad-brimmed hat, and wears an intricate ruffled collar. The man has detailed, patterned clothing with a medallion around his neck. The background includes Latin inscriptions in an oval border and script detailing his title below the image. The image is monochromatic resembling a detailed engraving.

artworks.title: James I
artworks.description: This engraving depicts a man with a pointed beard and mustache, wearing a large crown adorned with jewels. He has a sharp nose and deep-set eyes that look out at us. He is dressed in royal attire with a lace ruff, fur-trimmed robe, and a decorative collar. The man holds a scepter and an orb, both embellished with jewels. The image is surrounded by an emblematic border with inscriptions and a coat of arms at the bottom.

artworks.title: Matthias de l'Obel
artworks.description: The illustration shows the upper half of a mature man's body. He is positioned facing slightly to the left while looking directly at the viewer. The man has a prominent forehead, deep-set eyes, and a heavy beard and mustache. His hair is curly and receding. He wears a high-collared jacket with decorative buttons and holds a small branch or sprig of leaves in his right hand. Surrounding him is an elaborate border with classical architectural elements and cherubs holding cornucopias filled with fruit. The background displays detailed architectural engravings and Latin text inscriptions, including a name and date.

artworks.title: Henricus Montagu (Henry Montague, First Earl of Manchester)
artworks.description: The image displays a man from the chest up, seated and looking forward. He has a long face with a high forehead, narrow eyes, a thin nose, and a slightly curled mustache. His hair is short, wavy, and combed back, partially covering his ears. He wears a voluminous ruff around his neck, covered in lace or fine fabric, and a robe with a chain featuring detailed decorative elements. In his right hand, he holds a small book or document. The background is an intricately patterned frame with a Latin inscription around it, small heraldic emblems at the top corners.

artworks.title: Henricus Montagu (Henry Montague, First Earl of Manchester)
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a male figure in an oval frame. He is facing the viewer but slightly turned to his left, with a distinguished face featuring prominent cheekbones, a pointed nose, and a neatly trimmed mustache and goatee. His short hair is styled with a slight wave and brushed back. He wears a richly adorned garment with an elaborate lace ruff around his neck, and holds a baton or staff in his right hand. The background includes an oval with an inscription around the border and heraldic symbols in each corner of the rectangular frame. Latin text is inscribed below the portrait.

artworks.title: Henricus Percye (Henry Percy, Ninth Earl of Northumberland)
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, facing forward. He has a pointed beard and mustache, curly hair beneath a broad-brimmed hat, and is dressed in ornate historic noble attire with a high ruff collar. One hand holds part of his attire. In the background is a decorative oval frame with swirling patterns, framed by two cherubs. A coat of arms is at the top of the frame and below is scripted text with the man's titles and name.

artworks.title: Henricus Percye (Henry Percy, Ninth Earl of Northumberland)
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of a man in an elaborate oval frame. The man has a beard, mustache, and a tall hat, wearing a high lace collar and a patterned garment. He holds a staff and is surrounded by decorative details like cherubs holding scrolls, above which is a coat of arms. The background features intricate cross-hatching patterns.

artworks.title: Ernestus Earle of Mansfield
artworks.description: The engraving shows a man from the waist up, centered within an oval frame. He faces forward with his body slightly turned to his left, with one hand resting on his torso. His facial features include a high, slightly furrowed brow, prominent cheekbones, a pointed mustache, and a small beard. His hair is wavy and swept back. He wears a high-collared garment with buttons, a cloak or cape, and a decorated collar. The frame around him features ornamental scrollwork and winged cherubs in the background, each holding a book and quill. The background has intricate lines suggesting depth and texture.

artworks.title: Henricus Percye (Henry Percy, 9th Earl of Northumberland)
artworks.description: The image shows a man in an intricately detailed engraved portrait, with a long beard and styled hair. He is wearing ornate clothing with patterns and embellishments, including a high-collared tunic and a sash around his waist. The background features architectural designs and cherub-like figures in the corners. There is text around the oval frame and a block of text below the portrait.

artworks.title: Arthur O'Toole
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man's upper body with his head turned towards the viewer. He has a full, curly beard and mustache, and curly hair. He is dressed in armor with ornate detailing, wearing a decorative ruff. In his right hand, he holds an ornate staff. The portrait is encased in an oval frame with decorative scrollwork and text. The background features engraved patterns for texture and depth.

artworks.title: The Ladie Frances, Countesse of Hertford (Frances Howard)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman depicted from the waist up. She is positioned slightly turned to her right while looking directly at the viewer. She has delicate facial features, large eyes, and a small, composed mouth. Her hair is styled in an elaborate fashion, pulled back with soft curls framing her face and adorned with a small decorative piece at the top. She wears an intricately designed dress with a high, ruffled collar and patterned sleeves, embellished with detailed lacework and a richly embroidered bodice. A necklace with a prominent ornamental pendant falls along the neckline, and she holds a closed fan in her hand, resting her arms gracefully in front of her. The background features a detailed oval frame held by two cherubs, and there is an inscription within the border of the frame.

artworks.title: Frances Howard, Duchess of Richmond
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed portrait of a woman from the waist up. She is facing slightly to her right with a neutral expression. She has a round face, prominent eyes, and styled hair with a headpiece featuring jewels and plumes. The woman wears ornate clothing, a dress with lace details, a high collar, a necklace with a star-shaped pendant, and elaborate jewelry. Ribbon-like scrollwork frames her, and a coat of arms is at the top. The background includes ornate patterns and text.

artworks.title: Guliemus Segar (Sir William Segar, Garter King of Arms)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting a portrait of a man seated and facing the viewer. The man has a mustache and beard, with combed back hair. He wears elaborate clothing with a high lace ruffled collar, a adorned cloak, a detailed sash across his chest, and holds a staff. The background includes scrollwork, a coat of arms, angelic figures, inscriptions, and a scripted inscription at the bottom.

artworks.title: Guliemus Segar (Sir William Segar)
artworks.description: This is an engraving of a man from the waist up, facing slightly to the right but gazing directly at the viewer. The man has sharp eyes, a prominent nose, and a well-groomed mustache and goatee. His hair is short and curly or wavy. He wears elaborate clothing with a ruffled collar, ornate embroidery, a decorative sash, and regal accessories such as a staff, chain, and medallion. The background is adorned with ribbons and scrolling designs, with an inscription identifying the man as Sir William Segar. Above his head is a crest with two ravens and a shield. The image is set within an oval frame with intricate design work surrounding it.

artworks.title: Will Sommers, Kinge Henryes Jester
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with his right hand on his hip, looking directly at the viewer with a slight smile on his face. His facial features are somewhat angular, with a prominent nose and a receding hairline accentuating his bald head. His hair appears to be closely cut around the sides and back. He is dressed in an elaborate costume featuring a long, patterned robe tied at the waist with a sash, adorned with detailed embroidery and the initials "H.R." prominently displayed on his chest. Over this, he wears a cape-like garment, and his shoes are pointed with bows on them. A wide-brimmed hat with a large feather adorns his head. He holds a horn in his left hand. The background shows various buildings, including what appears to be a church steeple, and several small figures engaged in activities such as playing and acrobatics.

artworks.title: Will Sommers, Kinge Henryes Jester
artworks.description: The image shows a man in elaborate attire standing with a horn in his right hand. He wears a cap with a plume, a robe with puffed sleeves, a sash at his waist, and the letters "H.R." on his chest. He has a serious expression, closely cropped hair, and a pointed shoe. In the background, there is a town setting with various activities, buildings, and a church spire. The sky is filled with clouds and there is an inscription at the top.

artworks.title: Horaty Veer, Equitus (Horace Vere, Lord Vere of Telbury)
artworks.description: The image displays a man from the waist up within an elaborate frame. The man is in a slight three-quarter pose, facing slightly to the left. He has a rounded face with a prominent nose and a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. His hair is short and curly, with a receding hairline. The man is dressed in an ornate outfit with a high ruff around his neck, an embroidered coat, and visible shoulder plates indicating armor. In the background, there are decorative elements including a shield and emblems. Two figures in armor are depicted, one holding a shield and the other a lance. The composition is framed with Latin text, topped with images of horses and musical instruments. At the bottom, there is text identifying the person portrayed and details about the image's production.

artworks.title: John Williams, D.D., Archbishop of York and Lord Keeper
artworks.description: The image shows a man portrayed in a portrait from the waist up, positioned centrally in an oval frame. He is turned slightly to his left and has facial features including a short-trimmed beard and moustache. He wears a scholarly expression, a flat hat typical of the Renaissance, and a formal garment with a thick ruff around the neck and voluminous sleeves. He is holding a book in his right hand. Flanking him are two full-body statues of men in elaborate period attire with ruffs, doublets, and knee-length pants, each standing on ornate plinths. Above, five cherubic figures hold various items such as a book, a trumpet, a laurel wreath, and a lute against a backdrop of draped fabric and columns. The scene is rich in detail with decorative elements and inscriptions surrounding the figures in the intricate engraving.
